Name: Pink Satin Band
Author: thecouchwitch
Description:
Adding a touch of cuteness to a classic item. This is a self indulgent mod, I wear the straw hat pretty much exclusively and wanted to make it more to my personal tastes, and to coordinate it with the outfit my farmer wears.

I'm working on trying to make a SMAPI version but I'm having trouble with the manifest. If you have any experience with it I'd welcome some tips. Until then, I hope you enjoy the replacer .xnb version.

Install:
1. Download
2. Unzip it into Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Farmer
3. Override when the popup asks
4. You're done!

This probably isn't compatible with any other mods that edit the hats.xnb folder. It's my first Stardew mod and I'm still figuring things out. Like the overview says, it affects the straw hat that you win for collecting the most eggs at the egg festival.
